An LLM reads the fetched article body, decides whether each item is a concrete event (rejecting advisories, opinion and personal anecdotes), and groups reports of the same event so independent-source counts are real. Red requires an alertable type, severity>=0.75, corroboration (>=2 independent sources or a primary source) and >=3 matching social mentions.
